triggers: claims about human interaction, perceived safety, trust, reliance, workload, usability, acceptance, control, or shared environments
evidence_standards: Define the participant population, recruitment, task, environment, exposure, interface, and human-system role.
Use validated constructs and measures, or explicitly justify and limit novel or proxy measures.
Separate self-report, observed behavior, performance, physiology, and objective system outcomes.
Account for learning, novelty, demand characteristics, automation bias, calibration, accessibility, and individual differences.
Record ethics or human-subject review posture and consent constraints for research involving people.
safety_constraints: Do not equate trust, comfort, acceptance, or perceived safety with objective safety.
Do not generalize from an unrepresentative sample, short exposure, artificial task, or single interface without qualification.
Do not treat intended reliance as appropriately calibrated reliance without task- and capability-sensitive evidence.
